content_sections.heading: About TMC
content_sections.text: Tata Memorial Centre is described in the notice as a grant-in-aid institute under the Department of Atomic Energy, Govt. of India. This notice is issued by the Director (Academics), TMC, from Tata Memorial Hospital, Parel, Mumbai. It invites applications from Indian Nationals.

content_sections.text: The age limit is 40 years. The notice does not print a date for counting age.

content_sections.text: The tenure runs up to 31 July 2027. The notice mentions no other allowances.

faq.question: Q1. What is the date of the TMC Senior Resident walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 26 November 2026 at 02:00 P.M. Reporting is from 01:30 P.M. to 02:00 P.M.

faq.question: Q2. Where is the TMC Senior Resident interview held?
faq.answer: It is held at the Office of the Director (Academics), Homi Bhabha Block, 13th Floor, Room No. 1301, Tata Memorial Hospital, Parel, Mumbai.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Senior Resident in Nuclear Medicine at TMC?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is MD/DNB in Nuclear Medicine. The notice invites applications from Indian Nationals.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the TMC Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: The age limit is 40 years. It is relaxable by 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC and 10 years for physically handicapped candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a Senior Resident at Tata Memorial Hospital?
faq.answer: The consolidated remuneration for MD/DNB is Rs. 1,33,623 per month (gross pay).

faq.question: Q6. Until when is the Senior Resident tenure?
faq.answer: The tenure is up to 31 July 2027, as printed in the notice.

faq.question: Q7. Can I attend the TMC interview virtually?
faq.answer: Yes, the interview is in hybrid mode. Candidates attending through Hybrid Mode must email their CV/Resume with all certificates to [email protected] by 03:00 p.m. on 25 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What should I carry to the TMC walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Carry your Resume, Photo ID Proof, and original and attested copies of all qualification and experience certificates.

faq.question: Q9. Which department is the Senior Resident post in?
faq.answer: The post is in the Department of Nuclear Medicine & Molecular Imaging at Tata Memorial Hospital, Parel, Mumbai.
